name: Pozorrubio de Santiago (Spain)
description: Red field with a white saltire, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Pozorrubio (a well, a cross of Saint James and a bishop's staff).
history: Municipal flag of Pozorrubio; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Pozorrubio arms — well, cross of Saint James and staff
